definitions.explanation: Organized, competitive video gaming, especially played for spectators and prize money. From English "e-sports" (electronic sports); covers professional leagues, tournaments, and the broader scene around them.

examples.japanese: eスポーツ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{大会|たいかい}→大会：03386_taikai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見|み}→見る：00283_miru⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{行|い}った→行く：00119_iku⟧。
examples.english: I went to watch an esports tournament.

examples.japanese: ⟦{息子|むすこ}→息子：00799_musuko⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧eスポーツ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{選手|せんしゅ}→選手：03823_senshu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なりたい→なる：01970_naru⟧そうだ。
examples.english: My son says he wants to become an esports player.

examples.japanese: ⟦{近年|きんねん}→近年：14349_kinnen⟧、eスポーツ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{市場|しじょう}→市場：09685_shijou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{世界的|せかいてき}→世界的：20935_sekaiteki⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{拡大|かくだい}→拡大：02553_kakudai⟧⟦している→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: In recent years, the esports market has been expanding worldwide.

notes:
From English "e-sports." The "e" is written in a half-width Latin letter and read いー. Refers to competitive gaming as a spectator and professional activity.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- eスポーツ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{大会|たいかい}→大会：03386_taikai⟧: esports tournament
- eスポーツ⟦{選手|せんしゅ}→選手：03823_senshu⟧: esports player
- ⟦プロ→プロ：03871_puro⟧eスポーツ: professional esports

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦ゲーマー→ゲーマー：06259_geemaa⟧: gamer — a person who plays games, not the competitive scene itself
- ⟦{対戦|たいせん}→対戦：15338_taisen⟧⟦ゲーム→ゲーム：03842_geemu⟧: competitive (head-to-head) game — the genre often played in esports
